description:
Dear Team,

For the latest sustainability audit, the journey covered was a total of 125.4 km using public transport. During the same reporting period, our electricity consumption reached 342.7 kWh, and we generated 18.2 kg of waste. These figures will help us track our environmental impact and identify opportunities for improvement.
